# Shell command <TAB> comma-separated expected ShellAnalysis flags ("clean" = none).
# The test contract allows only the `src` subtree and network=allow.
cargo test	clean
git status	clean
git commit -m "checkpoint"	clean
ls -la	clean
git push origin main	push
git fetch origin	network
curl https://example.com/a	network
ssh deploy@example.com	network,remote
rsync example.com:/srv/x src/a	network,remote
rm -rf docs/old	destructive,writes_outside_scope
rm -rf src/old	clean
rm -rf /	destructive,writes_outside_scope
mv docs/a src/a	writes_outside_scope
echo hi > docs/out	writes_outside_scope
echo hi > src/out	clean
sudo ls	privileged,destructive
dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/x	destructive,privileged
kill 42	destructive
docker ps	remote
bash -c "git push"	push
eval "rm -rf /"	destructive,writes_outside_scope
$(echo hi)	ambiguous
<EMPTY>	ambiguous
